# Day Actions

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A support note within a Day Cluster listing discrete Action items tracked for that day.

## Scope note

Narrower than the general Action concept - the daily aggregation note, alongside DayLinks within DayClusterSupport.
